spring.provenance: 450 N/progression are catalogue-proxy assumptions, not this spring's measured force. 250 mm pin endpoint provisional; 080 interpreted as 80 mm stroke. Friction/damping are sensitivity hypotheses.

reflected_inertia.approximation: Diagonal approximation to B(q)^T J B(q), evaluated at default pose; omits cross terms. J_output=81*0.5*0.2kg*(0.035m)^2=0.0099225 kg m2 is a geometric rotor hypothesis, not a measured rotor.

joint_stop_solver.provenance: Numerical contact starts 0.04 rad inward so the stop decelerates before the original boundary; no angle boundary or violation tolerance enlarged.

passive_drive.provenance: Unmeasured gear/bearing drag hypothesis, tested over 0.5x..2x. Prevents frictionless wheel spin from being treated as a real disabled rest.

support.provenance: Explicit virtual stand: supports translation and orientation. All forces/moments logged and exactly zero before readiness; not a measured cardboard/support stiffness.

limitations: Physical zero references are inconsistent with the coarse surveyed pose; no firmware calibration changed.
Independent torque, pressure, hysteresis, rotor inertia and natural unsupported rest are unavailable.
Existing conservative knee boundaries retained; these are inherited source boundaries, not newly measured physical stops.
Ideal IMU attitude/gyro and encoder input to actual C odometry; real IMU filtering and CAN transport not reproduced.
Body inertia shape and serial equivalent mechanism inherited; only total mass adjusted.
Success is simulation-only and requires both wheels carrying force, no body contact, zero force AND moment assistance, 1 s dwell, 0.3 s handoff and 10 s balance.
New standing defaults and clearance command require a matching candidate firmware contract; existing low-stance actor acceptance does not transfer.
configuration.standing_provenance: Development target: 0.35 m hip height, CAD IK, inherited COM x; not measured. Selected from development-only dynamics scan; 12 s teacher probe, no autonomous get-up acceptance.

balance_transition: coalesce frozen 10 s outcome onto final learner transition
physics_backend: GPU MuJoCo Warp; CPU C-observer evaluation required
critic: 31D task-specific critic, no privileged actor input
